thread:
liam: PR #15821 is ready from my side but the CI queue is pretty backed up. Need to land before the infra maintenance (10:30 UTC today). Who can help with approvals or suggest a safe landing path? :eyes:
ci-bot: CI queue length: 42. ETA ~45m. Failing jobs: integration/mysql-conn (3/10 flaky), windows-matrix (timeouts). Last failure snippet:
```
FAIL integration/mysql-conn
AssertionError: expected 200 but got 500
  at tests/mysql_conn.test.ts:42:12
```
emma: If we miss the maintenance window, what breaks? rollback plan?
liam: The main concern is the schema migration that runs as part of this PR — post-maintenance we won't be able to run it until the DB team finishes rolling. Rollback is possible but the migration adds indexes used by the new API, so we'd need a coordinated rollback + hotfix. Not ideal.
jamie: I can do review now. won't be able to merge until CI green though. :+1:
sara: I can take the rebase/conflict work and run the flaky tests locally. Starting a local run now:
```
git fetch origin pull/15821/head:pr-15821
git checkout pr-15821
./scripts/run-integration.sh --filter mysql-conn
```
mohit: Ops note — maintenance is a soft reboot of a subset of nodes, but DB will be read-only for a short window. Safer option: land code behind a feature flag, then run migration in the following slot. Alternatively, we can do a targeted canary deploy to us-west-2 only, smoke test, then promote if clean. I can coordinate the canary.
deploy-bot: Manual canary deploy queued for canary/pr-15821 -> prod-us-west-2. Use `/deploy status canary/pr-15821` to check progress.
ops: Prefer no schema changes during maintenance. Can we split the migration into two smaller, non-locking steps?
liam: Unfortunately the migration is one atomic step for data integrity; splitting would add risk. Plan B: land with migration toggled off (feature flag), ship code only, then run migration in next maintenance slot. That reduces risk.
emma: Agree that land-with-flag is safest. We need 2 approvers + green CI. @jamie can you +1 after your quick pass? @sara can you post test results in ~20m?
jamie: Will do a quick sanity pass in 15m, can +1 if nothing obvious.
sara: Running flaky tests locally now, will paste logs in ~10m.
ci-bot: Rerun requested by sara: queued job integration/mysql-conn. Estimated start in ~30s.
jamie: Left one tiny nit in the diff (naming). Not blocking.
liam: Thanks all. Holding merge until CI green and we have two approvals. If CI is green before 10:05 UTC we'll merge and do canary then. Otherwise we postpone migration and land code-only behind flag. :thumbsup:
